remarks: First Floor Unit! This ranch-style condo with Hardwood floors at 50 Aiken St APT 382 brings together space, privacy, and convenience in one of Norwalk's most quietly set communities. Inside, the layout opens immediately to a bright living and dining area with hardwood floors and fresh paint, creating an easy flow for everyday living. The kitchen has updated stainless steel appliances and newly installed countertops, and it connects directly to the dining area with sliders that lead to a private deck overlooking a lightly wooded backdrop.  The bedroom wing includes a spacious en-suite with two closets and a remodeled full bath. A second bedroom sits beside another beautifully updated bath featuring new fixtures, a refreshed tub and shower, and modern vanities. Two new AC wall units add comfort throughout the warmer months. Laundry is located directly in the unit, and a dedicated basement storage area provides extra room for seasonal items.  Rolling Ridge offers a peaceful setting with mature landscaping, a relaxing in-ground pool beside the pond, and paddle tennis courts. Monthly common charges INCLUDE HEAT, HOT WATER, water, grounds care, and pool maintenance, Platform tennis, etc., adding simplicity to homeownership. The location places you close to the Route 7 connector for easy access to the Merritt Parkway and I-95, while nearby dining, shopping, and everyday essentials are just moments from home.
